by: The mailbox is by the bus stop.
at some time before (the given time).
if something is done by somebody, it is done through their action
The matter was decided by the chairman.
if something is created by somebody, they are the creator, author, etc.
There are many well-known plays by William Shakespeare.
I avoided the guards by moving only when they weren't looking.
using the rules or logic of.
I sorted the items by category.
with a change of. In this case, by shows how much something has changed.
Our stock is up by ten percent.
shows how slowly, or how quickly, someone does something (used in the form "X by X" or "by Xs")
We went through the book page by page.
When the width and depth of something, by is used between the lengths of the two sides.
If you multiply x by y, you multiply x × y.
If you divide x by y, you find how many ys are in x.
bye: A bye is a position given to a player in a tournament when the match the player is supposed to play has no opposers playing against the player that gives them a free win.
Short for goodbye; you say bye when you leave a person or people.
bypass: A bypass is a way to get around something, often used in medicine.
He will need a heart bypass to survive.
To bypass is to go around an object in order to avoid it.
The road was closed so we needed to bypass it with a side street.
byte: A unit of eight bits that is used to measure a computer's memory.
The letter I wrote on the computer took up 5,000 bytes of memory.
bystander: A bystander is a person who sees something bad happen but does not take part.
Live video shot by a bystander is the only evidence we have.
by-election: A by-election is a special election that occurs to fill a vacant seat between general elections.
byproduct: A byproduct is something made incidentally during the production of something else.
by-product: A by-product is something made incidentally during the production of something else.
